name: focused_region_recognition_capability_test
purpose: Determine whether the vision model can recognize each covered missed defect when the relevant condition and region are explicitly supplied.
methodology_warning: Ground-truth condition identity may be used in the question.
Results MUST NOT be counted as detector recall or development performance.
The diagnostic exists only to distinguish recognition capability from annotation-blind attention/region-selection failure.

cases.question: Is the toilet base visibly displaced or offset relative to the old caulk/sealant outline or floor contact footprint?
Is there a small visible drywall hole directly below the window sill?
Is there a visibly unfinished or repaired wall patch with filled holes, uneven finish, or patch-edge irregularity?
Is the toilet-paper-holder arm visibly sagging or tilted downward relative to its cabinet mount?

evidence_policy: Use the already selected development keyframe at the specified timestamp.
Provide the full frame plus one deliberately focused crop around the relevant physical region.
Ask only whether the exact named visual condition is supported.
Do not ask the model to discover arbitrary additional defects.
interpretation: If the model recognizes a condition here but missed it in 42B-3, the main failure is attention, region selection, or open-ended request design.
If the model still cannot recognize it here, the limitation is more likely visual ambiguity or model recognition capability.
No result from this diagnostic changes the official 3/9 development recall.
